header: What we do with your staff data
lead: A rota system holds names, hours, absence reasons and sometimes health data. This list covers everything we do with it, in words a works council can check.

items.title: Hosted in Vienna
items.text: Both copies of the data stay in the European Union, and nothing is processed outside it.

items.title: Encrypted in transit and at rest
items.text: TLS 1.3 on every connection, AES-256 on disk, and encrypted backups held for 35 days.

items.title: Role-based access
items.text: Managers see their own branch, and payroll sees the figures. Nobody sees why someone is absent without a valid reason.

items.title: Every view is logged
items.text: We record each time someone opens a person's record. The works council can see this log on request.

items.title: Deletion on a schedule
items.text: Personal data is deleted when the legal retention period ends, unless you tell us otherwise. We notify you before we delete it.

items.title: A processing agreement you can read
items.text: 11 pages, no annexes that refer to other annexes, and no new subprocessor without notice.

items.title: Independently tested
items.text: An outside firm we don't choose runs a penetration test every 12 months. Every customer gets the summary.

items.title: Your data leaves with you
items.text: CSV and JSON within 5 working days of your request, including the audit trail.
